messages:
Asha: Hey team, Prospect 'HelixAI' hitting errors on POC rerank. Getting 400 with 'embedding_dim_mismatch' and occasional 429s. Can we triage?
Tom: Copy. Ask for the exact request and encoder model.
Asha: They pasted: POST /v1/models/redwood-embed-512/encode { "input": [...], "batch_size":64 } then POST /v1/rerank { "query":"onboarding", "candidates": [[...vectors...]] } They said encoder returns 768 floats.
Priya: That explains the 400s — their vectors are 768 while rerank expects 512. Two choices: re-encode with the 512 encoder checkpoint (recommended) or use a temporary projection 768->512 (lossy).
Tom: 429s probably from large payloads + high concurrency. Recommend dropping batch_size to 8-16 and adding exponential backoff.
Asha: They shared error body: {"error":"embedding_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 512 but got 768"}
Priya: Quick mitigation we can do: add clearer error text and include header X-Embed-Expected:512 in responses, plus log a dim_mismatch metric. Low-risk.
ops-bot: Alert recorded: tenant helixai high-error-rate -> investigation mode.
Tom: I'll reach out to the customer to switch encoder config. Can we also offer a re-encode plan and cost ballpark?
Priya: Yes. I'll prepare a short cost estimate and suggest lazy migration: re-encode hot documents first. Also propose using our batch-encoding job runner and offer a discounted reserved slot for POC speed.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rerank-dim-improve v1.1.0 to staging — initiated by @Priya — ETA ~7m.
Asha: Customer also asked about persistence/security if we did server-side projection. Answer: embeddings live in tenant storage; any transient projection is ephemeral and not persisted unless requested. We'll provide a security note for their questionnaire.
Tom: Action items: (1) tell HelixAI to stop sending 768->512 mismatch, (2) lower batch_size, (3) add backoff, (4) we send cost estimate + offer batch slot. Will update thread.
Asha: Thanks all — looping customer in now.
